messages:
marco: Heads-up — post-canary metrics: payments service (chart payments v2.4.1) showing CPU p95 spike ~40% above baseline in eu-west after ~15m of traffic. Canaries healthy otherwise. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for payments 2.4.1 at 2025-11-12T09:40:12Z (canary=10%). Health checks passing, but autoscaler activity observed.

rachel: that spike looked correlated with bursty batch job traffic? any logs on sidecar?

marco: quick grep shows increased GC churn in app logs, nothing obvious in sidecar. Memory steady.

jess: options: 1) full rollback to 2.4.0, 2) pin canary (stop promotion) and patch autoscaler/burst config, 3) perform replica-swap to replace canary pods with previous chart replica set to drain any stateful-localism.

liam: I can do a replica-swap (drain canary pods and scale up stable RS) to reduce pressure fast — low blast radius and no image rollback. Do we want that as immediate mitigation?

marco: yes prefer minimal change now. Swap and monitor 10m. If still bad, we rollback.

rachel: agree. Make sure we annotate the release metadata so deploy-bot doesn't auto-promote.

liam: running commands now — will echo when done.

liam: ```
# drain canary pods, scale stable
kubectl -n payments label pod -l app=payments,canary=true canary-drained=true --overwrite
kubectl -n payments scale rs payments-stable-2-4-0 --replicas=3
kubectl -n payments scale rs payments-canary-2-4-1 --replicas=0
```

deploy-bot: Promotion job paused for payments (auto-promote disabled) — annotation payments/ci:promote=manual set by liam.

opsbot: Alert: incident channel flagged for on-call (pager duty).

jess: liam — once swap completes, open a short PR to pin chart in chartrepo with note "post-canary replica-swap: hold promotion" and add to release-notes draft. I'll take release-note blurb.

liam: swap finished at 2025-11-12T09:45:40Z. Observing p95 back to baseline after 2m. No errors on readiness probes.

marco: good. keep monitoring for 30m. Ops on-call please ack.

rachel: acked. adding short watch: `kubectl top pods -n payments --selector=app=payments` looks normal.

jess: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/charts/pull/172 — pins payments to 2.4.0 with annotation and release-note draft.

marco: decision: hold promotion, pin chart to 2.4.0, schedule follow-up eval in next release window to reproduce spike under load and test GC tuning. If patch ready, we'll re-promote in controlled canary with smaller concurrency.

liam: adding runbook note in the chart repo and tagging @oncall for handoff.

deploy-bot: Manual hold recorded. Canaries will not auto-promote for payments until annotation removed.

jess: release note blurb (for PR): "Hot mitigation: replica-swap to stable replicas following elevated CPU p95 observed in canary for payments 2.4.1. Promotion paused pending investigation; teams will evaluate GC and autoscaling settings before re-promotion."

marco: thanks everyone. I'll create a follow-up ticket with perf traces and assign to eng-runtime and payments owners. :thumbsup:

rachel: +1 — will run stress test in staging with same batch pattern and post results here.

liam: leaving the pin annotation for 24h, will escalate sooner if we see regression.

opsbot: on-call acknowledged: pagerduty.com/incident/PD-99823

marco: thread closed for now, will update when follow-up complete.
